known.title: Functional: Small changes can run only one fixed shard

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - An existing client has `groups = 4` and `fast_test = "vitest run --shard={group}/4"`. Forge accepts this configuration without a warning because `src/forge/quicktest.py:22` requires only `{group}`. For a small source change, the new matrix starts only group 1, while `src/forge/repo.py:693` cannot change the fixed denominator. Only shard 1 of 4 runs, so a failing selected test in another shard can be omitted while the required check passes. The owner-approved upgrade leaves existing test settings unchanged.
